animate_icons.name: Animate Mod Icons
animate_icons.description: Enables animated mod icons in the mods menu. This is applied when the mods menu is reloaded.

config_dancer.name: Show Dancing Canny in Config Menus
config_dancer.description:
Will you really ruin their rave?
( hides the dancing canny when in a config menu. )

ex_number.name: Number Option
ex_number.description: I am a description. I show up when this option is hovered over. Numbers will always default to SpinBoxes.

typehint_header.name: Type Hints
typehint_header.description: More advanced mod config options that use type hints.

ex_slider.name: Slider
ex_slider.description: A horizontal slider. You can set the min, max, and step.

ex_option_picker.name: Options Picker
ex_option_picker.description: The value of this option corresponds to the NUMERICAL INDEX of the option, and not the name!

ex_spinbox.name: Spin Box
ex_spinbox.description: A spin box. You can set the min, max, and step.
